record.paper_title: Recent developments and open problems in linear series
record.original_question: Let X be a smooth projective surface in characteristic zero. Does there exist a constant b(X) such that every reduced irreducible curve C on X satisfies C^2 ≥ -b(X)?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 3.3.1 (Bounded Negativity) Let X be a smooth projective surface in characteristic zero. There exists a positive constant b(X) bounding the self-intersection of reduced, irreducible curves on X.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a smooth projective surface over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero. A curve $C \subset X$ is called reduced and irreducible if its defining ideal sheaf is prime and has no embedded components. The self-intersection number $C^2 \in \mathbb{Z}$ is defined via the intersection pairing on the Néron–Severi group of $X$.

Prove or disprove: there exists a real constant $b(X) \ge 0$, depending only on $X$, such that
$$C^2 \;\ge\; -\,b(X)$$
for every reduced and irreducible curve $C \subset X$.
artifact.status_search_result: The Bounded Negativity Conjecture for smooth complex projective surfaces is a long-standing open problem, traceable back roughly a century. Recent work (2014–2025) addresses only special cases, weighted/weak variants, or particular surface classes (e.g., blow-ups, Fermat surfaces, line arrangements). A weak version has been established, but the full conjecture in characteristic zero remains open. It is known to fail in positive characteristic.

status_evidence.title: Bounded Negativity and Arrangements of Lines
status_evidence.snippet: The Bounded Negativity Conjecture predicts that for any smooth complex surface X there exists a lower bound for the self-intersection of reduced divisors on X. The conjecture is open.
status_evidence.claim: BNC is an open conjecture in characteristic zero.

status_evidence.title: Towards the weighted Bounded Negativity Conjecture for blow-ups
status_evidence.snippet: Weighted variants studied for blow-ups; original BNC remains open.
status_evidence.claim: Researchers continue to study weighted/weak variants because the original is unresolved.

status_evidence.title: On Weak bounded negativity conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: The weak bounded negativity conjecture is proved for all smooth projective surfaces.
status_evidence.claim: Only the weak version is established; full BNC remains open.
